text:
toni: thinking of two low-key options this weekend 3 sat night indie movie at the office projector (bring snacks) 3 sun morning coastal gravel ride (easy pace, 30-40km). who's up for either?

marcel: i'm down for the ride if there's coffee halfway. count me for both if the movie is PG-13 indie drama. :popcorn:

sheila: can't do sunday but movie sounds perfect. what time on saturday?

toni: movie start 7:30pm, doors 7. projector in the lounge. bring a blanket if you want to sprawl.

owen: @toni i have a spare front light and a pump if anyone needs for the gravel. what kind of gravel tires are people bringing?

zoe: i can lend a backup tube and a patch kit. where does the ride start?

marcel: @owen @zoe rules for tire width: 35-45mm recommended. start at lighthouse parking at 8:30, roll at 9. coffee stop at the marina cafe around 10:15.

toni: sweet. movie also will have a short 20-minute local shorts block before the feature. someone wants to host a 10-minute intro? i can do it.

sheila: @toni i'll intro the shorts. also i'll bring kombucha and a couple of gluten-free cookies.

devbot: reminder: office projector bookings require switching to "community events" mode in the room calendar. I've placed a tentative hold for Saturday 6:45-10:30pm. Link: https://calendar.company/events/186699

owen: @devbot thanks! quick Q - can the office AC stay on later if we have a full room?

devbot: sent request to facilities. they advised to log the event headcount by EOD Friday so HVAC can be adjusted.

zoe: for the ride carpool, i can take two from the north side (meet at 7:20 on Cedar & 5th). gas money appreciated.

marcel: @zoe i'll join your carpool, can bring two small coffee thermoses.

toni: poll time? who prefers: "Saturday movie + combos" or "Sunday gravel ride"? will keep both open but want a sense of numbers. @devbot can you drop a poll please.

devbot: Poll created: "Weekend plan preference" Options: "Saturday movie", "Sunday gravel ride", "Both". Voting open for 4 hours.

marcel: voted Both.

sheila: voted Saturday movie.

owen: voted Sunday gravel ride.

toni: looks like a split. plan: keep both events. if turnout for the ride is <4 we may switch to a coffee cruise instead. final logistics update Friday 6pm.

zoe: sounds good. i'll post a small checklist in the thread (pump, lights, layers). see you all either way! :mountain_biking_man:
